Bigin by Zoho CRM is a simplified, AI-ready customer relationship management (CRM) software designed specifically for small businesses, startups, and customer-facing teams.

Trusted by 50,000+ businesses across 150+ countries, Bigin helps small businesses unify all customer-facing operations — marketing, sales, onboarding, delivery, and support and helps manage customer relationships effectively.

## Bigin by Zoho CRM Media

[![Bigin by Zoho CRM Demo - Bigin - Team Pipeline View](https://www.g2.com/assets/transparent-ad5be28fbcd25b7b08d2cebe1d957125437fb5407d75ee717965ad22c8808791.gif)](https://images.g2crowd.com/uploads/attachment/file/139974/Team-Pipelines-_3_.jpg "Bigin - Team Pipeline View")

Unify all your customer-facing operations—marketing, sales, onboarding, support and manage them within Bigin. Create distinct pipelines for each customer operation and ensure your CRM is a single source of customer information.

[![Bigin by Zoho CRM Demo - Bigin - Bulit In Telephony](https://www.g2.com/assets/transparent-ad5be28fbcd25b7b08d2cebe1d957125437fb5407d75ee717965ad22c8808791.gif)](https://images.g2crowd.com/uploads/attachment/file/139976/Built-in-telephony.png "Bigin - Bulit In Telephony")

Always keep the conversations going with your customers and prospects with Bigin's built-in telephony. Make and receive calls from your CRM with features, such as personalized IVR, one-click calling and automatic call routing.

[![Bigin by Zoho CRM Demo - Bigin - Email In](https://www.g2.com/assets/transparent-ad5be28fbcd25b7b08d2cebe1d957125437fb5407d75ee717965ad22c8808791.gif)](https://images.g2crowd.com/uploads/attachment/file/139975/Emails.png "Bigin - Email In")

Bring your email accounts within Bigin to manage all your email interactions without switching tabs. Use mass emails to run effective email campaigns, get insights for every email you send and connect your email accounts with IMAP and POP3 support.

[![Bigin by Zoho CRM Demo - Bigin - Dashboards](https://www.g2.com/assets/transparent-ad5be28fbcd25b7b08d2cebe1d957125437fb5407d75ee717965ad22c8808791.gif)](https://images.g2crowd.com/uploads/attachment/file/1331925/Workflow-condition.png "Bigin - Dashboards")

Bigin's Dashboards help you stay on top of your performance and provide an in-depth analysis of your CRM data. Choose from a variety of pre-built dashboards or create your own.

[![Bigin by Zoho CRM Demo - Bigin - Workflow Automation](https://www.g2.com/assets/transparent-ad5be28fbcd25b7b08d2cebe1d957125437fb5407d75ee717965ad22c8808791.gif)](https://images.g2crowd.com/uploads/attachment/file/1331926/Workflow-condition.png "Bigin - Workflow Automation")

Bigin's workflow automation reduces your workload and cuts down on repetitive manual tasks. Save time by simply creating condition-based actions to automate daily activities.
